label: ASSUMED actuator timing and body IMU noise; illustrative, NOT hardware measurements
noise_model: Independent zero-bias IID Gaussian samples at 500 Hz, body pitch/rate ONLY (state indices 2/5). Other coordinates are explicitly ideal measurements.

experiment.protocol: Inherit ALL initial states, 10s duration, pulse, thresholds and Q/R from base_config unchanged.
experiment.gain_selection: Run frozen nominal K across every case FIRST. Only if any case FAILS, synthesize per-delay augmented DARE on the actual runtime step and repeat ALL cases with identical seeds. No Q/R/noise/threshold tuning.
experiment.augmented_cost: dt * (six_state.T Q six_state + clipped_command.T R clipped_command); zero extra state penalties; nominal Q/R unchanged.
experiment.completion: Exit 0 means complete retained experiment; individual FAIL statuses are never promoted to PASS.

frozen_nominal.archive_comparison: K_used exactly equal (array_equal) on original pinned Mac environment
frozen_nominal.synthesis: sim.lqr.synthesize(Plant(base_config)); solver DARE; 2ms nominal RK4; unchanged Q/R
